_: THE QUESTIONS THE DOOR ASKS ITSELF (Create Indicator, clarify first). Owner direction, 2026-11-18: when a choice that changes the maths is not settled, ask ONE short question with the options before building; never guess. Each entry is a question the door can ask with no model call: `text` is what the member reads, `choices` what they can tap. Every choice is a phrase the door reads back as that choice, so tapping it (or typing it) settles the question; `tests/test_clarify_registry.py` holds each one to that. WHEN a question is open is code, not data (`definition_conversation.open_questions`), read from what the planner already found. The ORDER here is the order asked: one question per turn, the first that is open. A choice that is a convention the product already holds (RSI 14 of the close, MACD 12/26/9, a library entry's own numbers) is never a question here. `also` lists the plain words a member may TYPE for a choice ("simple", "exponential"); an answer holding one is read as that choice.

questions.open_when: the request says moving average (or MA, DMA) and names no kind of average
the request asks for an average and gives no number anywhere
questions.text: How many bars should the average use?

questions.open_when: the request says price crosses something and does not say whether on the close or as soon as it trades through
choices: When the bar closes across it
As soon as price trades through it
